notes.title: The Hardest Thing Ever Patch Notes [10/17/20]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38648515/f45b95e12b3ebfe08d3ba9bafcd1b5b33bf291f8.jpg[/img]

A big new update 1.1 is available for The Hardest Thing Ever now. This update will automatically install when starting the Steam client, if it doesn’t install automatically, please restart Steam.

NEW GAME MECHANICS
[list]
[*] Added the "Fan mechanic", solve puzzles with the power of wind;
[/list]

ENHANCEMENTS
[list]
[*] Added One new room, the Kitchen;
[*] Added 18 levels with new game mechanics;
[*] Improved some game physics.
[/list]

GENERAL BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Leaderboards are working correctly now;
[*] Optimization and increase performance.
[/list]
